layout_panel.name: instances_section

check_box.label: Show ghosts
check_box.name: show_all_check
check_box.tool_tip: Master visibility: hide every ghost at once without losing the per-ghost enables. Session-only

layout_panel.text: Styled copies of cast bodies: place, pose, multiply. Double-click a row to show/hide it

check_box.label: Edit ghosts
check_box.name: edit_ghosts_check
check_box.tool_tip: Edit ghosts in world: click a ghost to select it, drag to move it on the ground, Shift-drag to turn it, click empty ground to re-place the selection, Delete removes it. Esc (or unchecking) hands the camera back. Spinners below stay the precision path

scroll_list.name: ghost_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: Every ghost instance. Select a row to edit it below; double-click toggles it on/off. Ghosts keep rendering when their source avatar is off-camera or impostored; a LIVE ghost's pose updates coarsely while its source is out of view (freeze to lock it)

combo_box.name: source_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Whose body the new ghost copies: you, or any cast member

flyout_button.label: Add Overlay Ghost
flyout_button.name: btn_ghost_add
flyout_button.tool_tip: Choose the fixed type of ghost to add

button.label: Duplicate
button.name: btn_ghost_dup
button.tool_tip: Copy the selected ghost (including a frozen pose) one step to its left

button.label: Refresh
button.name: btn_ghost_refresh
button.tool_tip: Re-sync this entity clone to its source's current appearance and worn attachments

line_editor.label: Name
line_editor.name: ghost_name
line_editor.tool_tip: Session-only ghost name. Duplicate names are allowed; identity remains the internal instance id

spinner.label: Yaw (deg)
spinner.name: yaw_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Exact ghost heading in degrees; stays synchronized with the live heading dial

compass_dial.name: heading_dial
compass_dial.tool_tip: Ghost heading: drag the needle to rotate the selected ghost live; mouse wheel trims 5 degrees per click

spinner.label: Scale
spinner.name: scale_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Uniform size, pivoted at the feet so they stay planted (1 = life size)

button.label: Place (click ground)
button.name: btn_place
button.tool_tip: Arm one ground click: the next click on ground/prim puts the ghost's feet there. Esc or right-click cancels

button.label: To actor
button.name: btn_to_actor
button.tool_tip: Snap the ghost onto its source's current feet

button.label: To me
button.name: btn_to_me
button.tool_tip: Snap the ghost onto your avatar's current feet

combo_box.name: style_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Render style, same looks as the path pose ghosts. Ghost: translucent tint. Clone: unlit textured copy (covers worn mesh, attachments and PBR emissive; legacy system-mesh eyeballs are a known gap). Hologram: cyan scanlines. Wireframe: hidden-line wire. X-ray: glowing silhouette

check_box.label: Actor hue
check_box.name: actor_tint_check
check_box.tool_tip: Tint from the source's stable path color (matches its path/ghost hue). Uncheck to pick a hue with the slider

slider.label: Hue
slider.name: hue_slider
slider.tool_tip: Tint hue (degrees) when Actor hue is off

slider.label: Pixelate
slider.name: pixel_slider
slider.tool_tip: Screen-space pixelation block size (px). 0 = off. Reads strongest on the Clone style

slider.label: Shimmer Hz
slider.name: shimmer_speed_slider
slider.tool_tip: Shimmer speed (wobbles per second); only matters when Amount is above 0

slider.label: Amount
slider.name: shimmer_amount_slider
slider.tool_tip: Shimmer depth: brightness/alpha wobble, phase-offset per ghost so crowds do not strobe together. 0 = off

slider.label: Glitch
slider.name: glitch_slider
slider.tool_tip: Broken-signal effect: horizontal slices tear sideways with a chroma split. 0 = off

slider.label: Brightness
slider.name: brightness_slider
slider.tool_tip: Output brightness: the ghost is unlit, so a clone reads fullbright in a night scene. Dial down (~0.3-0.5) to sit it into dark sets; 1 = as authored

button.label: Grab pose now
button.name: btn_freeze
button.tool_tip: FREEZE: snapshot the source's current pose into this ghost (worn mesh + attachment placement). The ghost holds it while the live body keeps animating. Known limits: flexi tails/skirts keep their live physics motion, and legacy system-mesh eyeballs are not part of the ghost

button.label: Follow live
button.name: btn_live
button.tool_tip: Drop the frozen pose; the ghost mirrors the source's live animation again

combo_box.name: drive_mode_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Entity animation drive: mirror its source, play a local animation asset, or hold the current pose

check_box.label: Chaos
check_box.name: chaos_check
check_box.tool_tip: Deterministic per-clone position, yaw and uniform-scale variation

slider.name: chaos_slider
slider.tool_tip: Chaos amount (0..1); stable for this clone's instance id

combo_box.name: entity_look_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Client-only entity render look. Apparition is scaffolded this pass; advanced shaders are deferred

line_editor.label: Animation UUID
line_editor.name: directed_anim_editor
line_editor.tool_tip: Animation asset UUID played only on the selected entity clone

spinner.label: Copies
spinner.name: array_count_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Total ghosts in the array (the selected one counts as the first)

spinner.label: Spacing
spinner.name: array_spacing_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Metres between neighbouring ghosts in the array

button.label: Line
button.name: btn_array_line
button.tool_tip: Duplicate the selected ghost into a line along its facing

button.label: Ring
button.name: btn_array_ring
button.tool_tip: Duplicate the selected ghost into a ring around it, each copy facing outward
